# TPC-DS-OBT Q61

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT promotions, total, CAST(promotions AS DECIMAL(15, 4)) / NULLIF(CAST(total AS DECIMAL(15, 4)), 0) * 100 FROM (SELECT SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS promotions FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk AND obt.promo_sk = obt.promo_p_promo_sk AND obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk AND obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = -6 AND obt.item_i_category = 'Books' AND (obt.promo_p_channel_dmail = 'Y' OR obt.promo_p_channel_email = 'Y' OR obt.promo_p_channel_tv = 'Y') AND obt.store_s_gmt_offset = -6 AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 11) AND channel = 'store') AS promotional_sales, (SELECT SUM(obt.ext_sales_price) AS total FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt WHERE (obt.sold_date_sk = obt.sold_date_d_date_sk AND obt.store_sk = obt.store_s_store_sk AND obt.ship_customer_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_customer_sk AND obt.bill_addr_ca_address_sk = obt.bill_customer_c_current_addr_sk AND obt.item_sk = obt.item_i_item_sk AND obt.bill_addr_ca_gmt_offset = -6 AND obt.item_i_category = 'Books' AND obt.store_s_gmt_offset = -6 AND obt.sold_date_d_year = 1998 AND obt.sold_date_d_moy = 11) AND channel = 'store') AS all_sales ORDER BY promotions, total LIMIT 100
```
